title: Reconcile merged Codex research remediations
objective: Prevent merged Codex research-remediation pull requests from remaining or reappearing as IN_REMEDIATION solely because a CODEX_RESEARCH_COMPLETION_RECEIPT_v1 was not materialized. Add deterministic post-merge reconciliation that verifies the bound PR and merge commit before producing the existing completion contract, then lets the current maturation engine advance the task through post-fix observation or resolution.

evidence.summary: Prospective shared-row P0 remediation is merged at f7de1f0b92278d3d887077d40d61fc453fc9e084, but the latest queue still reports its research-intake task as IN_REMEDIATION.
Operations pointer-truth remediation is merged at 1c7613d9511d1a21c34bb99ea36a74891d034f8b, but the latest queue still reports its research-intake task as IN_REMEDIATION.
The repository already defines the canonical verified completion receipt, but writing it requires a separate manual invocation after merge.
A valid completion receipt is already understood by the intake merger, so the missing layer is deterministic post-merge materialization/reconciliation rather than a new lifecycle contract.

reproduction: On fresh main, read research/remediation/LATEST_REMEDIATION_QUEUE.json and observe candidate codex-research-prospective-p0-validity-repair-v1 in IN_REMEDIATION even though PR 519 is merged. Confirm research/codex/completions/codex-research-prospective-p0-validity-repair-v1.json is absent. Repeat for codex-operational-observability-pointer-truth-v1 and merged PR 562. Run the existing maturation plus research-intake merge without a completion receipt and verify the candidates remain active, demonstrating the lifecycle gap.

positive: A valid CODEX_RESEARCH_TRANSITION_RECEIPT_v1 with a bound PR number whose PR is verified merged produces exactly one hash-valid CODEX_RESEARCH_COMPLETION_RECEIPT_v1 with the actual merge commit SHA.
A valid transition with pr_number null but a unique exact branch-bound merged PR can be reconciled without guessing and records that exact PR and merge SHA.
After reconciliation, the existing research-intake merger no longer emits the task as IN_REMEDIATION and follows its existing post-fix/resolution semantics.
The known merged PR 519 and PR 562 stale tasks are cleared from active remediation after the governed reconciliation path runs.
negative: An open, closed-unmerged, mismatched-branch, ambiguous, or unverifiable PR must not produce a completion receipt.
A transition receipt with invalid hash, changed candidate hash, changed task-contract hash, or non-IN_REMEDIATION state must not be reconciled.
An existing valid completion receipt is idempotent and cannot be overwritten with different bytes.
GitHub API unavailability must fail closed or preserve the task as active, never fabricate completion or resolution.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already deterministically materializes verified completion receipts for merged research-remediation PRs and both PR 519 and PR 562 are absent from active remediation for that reason.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if the reproduction no longer holds or the implementation would require automatic merging, broader GitHub write authority, framework semantics, or guessing PR identity.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER only if deterministic merge verification cannot be achieved using existing transition bindings and current GitHub Actions read authority.
rollback_plan: Revert only the bounded completion-reconciliation code/workflow changes. Preserve all historical transitions, completion receipts and execution ledgers as audit evidence.
